difficulty_reason: The lemma proves functoriality of derived restriction in the bimodule and that quasi-isomorphisms of bimodules induce isomorphisms of functors (statement lines 5288-5299). The proof (lines 5301-5351) is a genuine four-beat argument: the property-(I) assembly of the transformation, the reduction to the filtered quotients through the Rlim computation with split transition maps, an induction on the filtration through the induced maps of short exact sequences, and the final reduction to the dual map via products of shifts of the B-dual and exactness of the dual. H2: the individual lemmas are standard, but the induction structure and the two reduction steps carry the proof and no step is a bare citation.
